meta.scope: C3 verification — overlay scrim, semibold token, aria-current

results.title: Both new tokens resolve on :root in the real window

checks.label: --oc-weight-semibold resolves to 600
--oc-overlay-scrim is defined
--oc-overlay-scrim derives from --oc-bg-app rather than a literal
the pre-existing weight ramp is untouched (additions-only)

results.title: Live-DOM weight census — converted selectors at 600, ramp respected

checks.label: at least one C3-converted selector is on screen to judge
every rendered C3-converted selector computes font-weight 600
no element computes a weight outside the 400/500/600/700 ramp

notes: distinct computed font-weights in the live DOM: 400, 500, 600

results.title: NewPodDialog — scrim veils, heading and bypass warning at 600

checks.label: scrim found as the dialog parent
scrim is position:fixed full-window
scrim background has alpha strictly between 0 and 1
COMPOSITING: two scrim regions with different content behind them differ
dialog heading computes 600
CONTROL: forced OPAQUE, the same two regions become byte-identical
checks.detail: identical -> the probe DOES detect opacity, so every COMPOSITING check here is meaningful

notes: bypass warning not rendered in default permission mode; not asserted

results.title: DeletePodDialog — scrim veils, heading and subject at 600

checks.label: createPod succeeded
a Pod tab is rendered after createPod
scrim background has alpha strictly between 0 and 1
COMPOSITING: scrim regions over different content differ
delete heading computes 600

results.title: PanelBar: aria-current carries open state AND still paints it

checks.label: exactly one panel button reports aria-current="true"
the open one is helm
NO panel button carries aria-pressed any more
the closed buttons are distinguishable from the open one
PAINT: the open button renders a different background than a closed one

notes: That paint check is the one jsdom cannot make: the attribute rename also had to move the stylesheet selector, and had it not, every renderer test would still pass while the open panel lost its highlight.

results.title: Helm close-confirmation scrim veils the window

checks.label: the close confirmation appeared on a dirty draft
confirmScrim background has alpha strictly between 0 and 1
COMPOSITING: confirmScrim lets differing content through
the draft was discarded, so nothing blocks later steps

results.title: Beachcomber preview scrim veils the window

checks.label: a Beachcomber row could be selected
preview scrim background has alpha strictly between 0 and 1
COMPOSITING: preview scrim lets differing content through

results.title: Positive control: the compositing probe can detect an opaque scrim

checks.label: with the shipped token, the two regions DIFFER
forced OPAQUE, the same two regions become byte-identical
checks.detail: identical -> the probe does detect opacity, so the checks above are meaningful
